title: ELoM creator asset revival
hypothesis: Existing game-world artifacts can be refined into a small paid creator or player experience without rebuilding the entire historical system.
target_buyer: Players, creators, collectors, and fans of persistent digital worlds.
channel: Existing ELoM artifacts, community discovery, Substack, Reddit
smallest_test: Archaeologise one coherent historical mechanic, package a tiny playable or demonstrable slice, and test paid interest before rebuilding the wider game.
kill_condition: Artifact cannot be reconstructed coherently, or no qualified demand appears after a bounded demonstration test.
